diagnostic_definitions.SL_path: Only entry_index <= j < exit_index; no exit-bar OHLC read. Each completed close signed return compared with max(20, modeled roundtrip+accrued absolute funding at j).
entry_features: ST current episode start and age, no age threshold
previous actual admitted same-side attempt since last ST direction switch; previous terminal outcome only if exit_ts<=signal_ts
native signed EMA distance and EMA slope, ATR-normalized native ST distance
existing prior candle confirmation and existing freshness state
diagnostic_definitions.large_winner: existing sprint metrics definition: top ceil(0.1 * positive completed winners), diagnostic labels only
diagnostic_definitions.late_recovery: winner whose first completed held-bar close is nonpositive gross, later completed close exceeds contemporaneous modeled cost
diagnostic_definitions.counterparts: same zero-state and native direction episode features, separately ordinary/large winners and initial SL
diagnostic_definitions.blocked_signals: UNKNOWN outcomes; entry features only; no proxy zero/loss
diagnostic_definitions.candidate_hypothesis_pre_scan: Potential adverse signal-candle veto at signed(close-open)<0; root owns choice only after distinctness and evidence review.
